cards.consumerAndFactSource: Planned planNext destination reselection scans existing world.sites and reads site fields plus nearby cave/artifact content through siteHasContent; arrival and rewards remain owned by existing site consumers.
cards.settlementObjects: One planning entity and world.sites; only formations and caves for which siteHasContent is false are excluded. Secret realms and ruins remain eligible for their existing generic rewards.
cards.timePrecision: Only when planNext reselects a destination; not per frame or on every step.
cards.worstCaseCost: O(S + nearby cave/artifact content checks), where S is the full world.sites length. Radius 30. No hard candidate-count cap, to avoid changing reachability. No saved search index or history scan.
cards.queryMethod: One linear scan of the existing world.sites array and local radius checks. No persistent active-site index. siteHasContent validates nearby cave/artifact content using existing official objects.
cards.rngContract: Filtering/search adds no RNG draws. Preserve the existing downstream choice/tie RNG path; ties retain the array's existing order where the existing chooser is stable. Any changed or additional draw is a reviewed B-class behavior change.
cards.cacheInvalidation: No cross-call cache; each reselection reads current positions, site state, artifact ownership/content, and entity location.
cards.dataLifetime: No new persistent or warm/cold search data; only existing selected-target plan state is retained.
cards.failureAndExit: A result is a nearby candidate, not proof of path reachability; current planNext does not run pathfinding here. Missing or stale sites are handled by existing planning/arrival behavior; no new cancellation protocol is introduced.
cards.testEvidence: Controlled empty/content-bearing cave, secret/ruin generic reward, radius boundary, array-order tie, stale target, deterministic RNG-path and save/replay checks; implementation review pending.
